record_scope_reconstruction: Shahn/ Shihan Yemeni land-port customs area on the M100 road to Al Mazyunah, Oman. Traders protested Yemeni customs charges at the port; this is not a closure established at the Omani terminal.

source_checks.finding: Full original March 6, 2022 article states that traders closed Shahn land port and vowed to continue until their customs-fee demands were met. It supplies no exact barrier location or verified reopening.

The exact 2022 protest barrier within the customs area remains unknown. Inspected OSM tags: {"barrier": "border_control"}.
